environment.description: Celery worker deployed via Kubernetes with container security context specifying readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. Pod spec does NOT include any emptyDir, hostPath, or tmpfs volumeMounts. The only volume is a projected serviceAccountToken at /var/run/secrets. Container image uses distroless base with no shell. SecurityContext also sets allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and drops ALL capabilities. Note: the broker (Redis) still accepts connections from the worker pod on the overlay network without authentication.
